notices.title: Update · New home screen and user panel
lines: Notices, illustration and feedback are now gathered on the home screen.
Open the story list from the ☰ menu at the top left.
Type a category name such as "Main" or "Events" in search to jump straight to that list.
The user button at the top right shows your professor name, last record and bookmarks in one place.
Settings include brightness, font, theme and language.
Please report bugs through the feedback form.

notices.title: Update · Bookmarks and search
lines: Save records with the ☆ bookmark on the reading screen.
Search a character name to see the chapters they appear in most.
You can also search occasions and themes like "Valentine" or "Summer".
Fixed text looking too small on phones.

notices.title: About the 42LAB Record Archive
lines: The 42LAB Record Archive is an unofficial fan site that lets you reread the stories of Girls' Frontline: Neural Cloud like messenger chats.
It is a personal fan project unrelated to the game company, and it makes no money.
Story text is taken as-is from the game. Typos in the original may remain.
Read in English · 日本語 · 繁體中文 · 简体中文 · 한국어. Stories that exist only on the CN server are fan translations.
[Copyright]
All copyrights to the stories, characters, images and names of Girls' Frontline: Neural Cloud belong to their owners (Sunborn Network Technology Co., Ltd. / MICA Team).
The 42LAB Record Archive is an unofficial fan site unrelated to the game company and earns nothing.
Stories here are for reading and record keeping. Please do not copy, redistribute or use them commercially.
If the rights holders ask, the content will be taken down or the site closed immediately.
[Privacy]
There is no sign-up, and no personal data is collected.
Settings such as nickname, theme and reading position are stored only in your browser and are deleted with your browser data.
[Bug reports]
There are no individual replies. Fixes are announced in notices and on X.
Typos in the original game text are kept as they are, so they may not be fixed right away.

notices.title: Update · First features
lines: Messenger-style reading screen: dialogue bubbles, inner-thought bubbles, narration, letters
Professor nickname: how characters address the professor shows your nickname.
Choices: the story follows your answer; see every branch with other choices or "Show all".
World Record links: tap orange words for an explanation.
Episode numbers, battle dialogue labels (e.g. 09.1) and Dark Zone markers
Main · Events · Character · Collab · Escort · Special · Other categories
Brightness and themes: Light · Dim · Dark (+ hidden themes)
Reading modes: Normal · Easy-read
Continue reading: remembers where you left off.
